questions.prompt: The bash plugin starts before the identity plugin. Where does the identity text appear in the rendered prompt?
options: After the bash text, because bash registered first
First, because its order -1000 is the lowest
It depends on the plugin names only
questions.explanation: render() sorts by order, not by start time. The identity section has order -1000, so it always comes first.

questions.prompt: Why does it matter that the same plugins always render the same bytes?
options: The model reads sorted text faster
An unchanged request start gives a prefix cache hit
Plugins can then skip their disposers
questions.explanation: The provider reuses work when a request begins with the same bytes. A fixed sort keeps the system prompt identical between steps.

questions.prompt: The bash plugin stops. What happens to its section?
options: Its disposer deletes it, and the next render has no bash text
It stays until the session ends
Its text becomes an empty line in the prompt
The harness throws because a section is missing
questions.explanation: section() returns a disposer, and the plugin's disposers run when it stops. Empty or removed sections leave no blank lines.
